row.name: Orakyubu
row.detailed_description: Orakyubu is a game about 2D puzzles in 3D space. To compete each puzzle, you will need to push boxes onto every target. However, there's a catch - each puzzle is contained on the faces of cubes. It is possible, and usually necessary, to move the pieces of each puzzle across the faces of their cube as well as onto other cubes to solve the puzzle. Orakyubu contains around 25 puzzles. Each one requires you to approach it in a unique way, so no two puzzles are the same.
row.short_description: A game about 2D puzzles in 3D space.

row.name: Farm Defense
row.detailed_description: Farm Defense is a standalone game inspired by the Warcraft 3 mod ‘Random Farm’. Enjoy the nostalgic experience with new features and content. Create Your Own Luck Enjoy a skill based game that has added excitement through random elements. Out skill the random number generator while taking on increasingly difficult enemy waves. Progression Enjoy countless hours of fun with multiple difficulties, levels, and unlocks to obtain. Multiplayer Embark on a solo journey or battle through the enemy waves with up to 8 friends. Customization Unlock characters and cosmetics through the leveling system and display to everyone in the lobby that you are the most skilled. Control The Market Manage your resources by choosing which crops to plant and harvest. Each wave the market will have new prices, try to wait for that ‘fire’ day! Features 40 waves Difficult bosses Upgradable damage types In-game missions 49 defenders Crop market
row.short_description: Farm Defense pits you against waves of increasingly difficult enemies in a Tower Defense environment. Mitigate the random elements to defend the farm. Conquer all 40 waves to live and fight another day.

row.name: Alpaca Stacka
row.detailed_description: Alpaca Stacka is a 3D adventure platformer where you play as Paz, a kind alpaca dedicated to helping their animal friends. Explore the island to collect Mama Hen's lost chickens See Streusel, the mischievous squirrel, follow you around the island Credits Sebastian Baracaldo | Developer Michelle Ma | Developer Zafire Dragoon | Composer Additional Development by Spookulele Games
row.short_description: A 3D adventure platformer where you play as a kind alpaca dedicated to helping their animal friends.
row.reviews: “It was so relaxing, it brought me vibes of Chill and Beautiful Nintendo Game.” sir_basstian “What a beautiful game!” Agar3s “I liked the level design, it lets the player explore while giving clues to guide her” Carenalga

row.name: Star Trek Prodigy: Supernova
row.detailed_description: Play as Dal R’El and Gwyndala, and rescue their scattered crew. Play solo or in 2-player cooperative mode in this exciting action adventure.  After the Protostar picks up strange readings from a dying star, Dal R’El and Gwyndala race against time to save their friends, their ship, new alien species and an entire planetary system before a supernova destroys them all! Explore the alien worlds of Orisi, Mirios and Taresse, each with its own hostile environments, puzzles, challenges and mysteries. When the Protostar’s malfunctioning transporter scatters the crew across three alien planets, Dal and Gwyn must use their wits and skills to overcome ingenious puzzles, endure hostile environments and battle deadly robot armies to rescue Jankom Pog, Rok-Tahk, Zero and Murf. But as they search for their friends, they soon discover a sinister and deadly new enemy, one that will stop at nothing to destroy the Protostar and change the very course of history!  Make first contact with new alien species, learn about their history and discover their secrets.  Battle a deadly new adversary and his robot army in thrilling combat encounters.
row.short_description: Dal R’El and Gwyndala race against time to save their friends, their ship, new alien species and an entire planetary system before a supernova destroys them all, while battling a deadly new enemy that will stop at nothing to destroy the Protostar and change the very course of history!

row.name: A MIRROR PUZZLE
row.detailed_description: 'A MIRROR PUZZLE' is a puzzle game. The core mechanism of the game is the replication or displacement of mirror images. A water elf and a mirror elf are companions to purify the polluted water source, revive the sleeping forest, and finally unravel the mystery of forest pollution. The player will play the role of a water drop elf. By using various magic mirrors to control the symmetrical growth of plants or the positional transformation of certain scene elements, overcome many difficulties and finally reach the end, so as to lift the curse of the forest and explore the truth of forest pollution. Game Features Smart and cute art style The interactive pleasure of manipulating space Novel and rich gameplay Use 'Ground Mirror' to change the space Use the 'human mirror' to travel through space Mirror an item using an 'objective mirror'
row.short_description: 'A MIRROR PUZZLE' is a puzzle game. Players will play as a water droplet spirit, through the use of various magic mirrors to control the symmetrical growth of plants or the position of certain scene elements change, overcome numerous difficulties, and finally reach the destination

row.name: Turbo Tempest
row.detailed_description: Turbo Tempest is a multiplayer speedboat battle arena where you fight to be the last one standing. Use 8 distinct weapons to fight your opponents and pick between 6 different speedboats Battle in the jungle, in the desert or in the artic with up to 8 players This game was developed as a learning project by me, thus why it is free and only supports player hosted games. I plan on doing some bug fixing once the game is released but no plans of adding extra or paid content, unless there is major interest. Bots have been added to fill games, simply add how many bots you want in the lobby, note that only a combined total of 8 players and bots can spawn on any map. The bots aren't very smart and are meant to be filler, but they are fun to shoot at!
row.short_description: A Multiplayer Speedboat Battle Arena where you fight to be the last boat standing using a range on weapons on the map.

row.name: TETRAGUN
row.detailed_description: In TETRAGUN you control a turret surrounded on all sides by unrelenting waves of enemies. After each wave, you'll choose from a wide variety of upgrades that will help you survive and allow you to discover powerful synergies. Unfortunately for you, your enemies will also gain access to upgrades and abilities that will make them more of a threat. Each run of TETRAGUN is randomized, so you'll need to be adaptable to make it out in one piece. Quadrant Based In TETRAGUN, the battlefield is separated into four quadrants. Your turret will only be able to aim within one quadrant at a time, requiring you to rotate between them on the fly. This takes time, so deliberate prioritization is the key to success. Score Big Shoot for the highest score you can! Enemies are worth more score the earlier you eliminate them, and chaining eliminations together quickly will boost your score multiplier. Completely Free The entirety of TETRAGUN is available for free and features zero micro-transactions. Features 25 Turret Upgrades 8 Enemy Upgrades 5 Weapons 5 Abilities 4 Difficulties 30+ Steam Achievements Layered soundtrack composed by Kayla Okus
row.short_description: TETRAGUN is quadrant-based shooter where you're surrounded on all sides. You'll gain powerful upgrades as you progress, but so will your enemies.

row.name: Arena Tactics

Use Champions from various myths and folklore, lead them on the battlefield in a turn-based and fast-paced tactical strategy battle. TURN-BASED STRATEGY BATTLE Control your Champions on the hexagonal battlefield, the fast and fun battle system is easy to play but hard to master. Each Champion has a full set of abilities, stats and a specific playstyle. GLORY ROAD & BATTLE PASS Fight and progress in the game to unlock rewards, Champions and special prizes UNLOCK AND UPGRADE CHAMPIONS Dozen Champions to collect, upgrade and level up for multiple strategies and combinations. FEATURES ● 18 Champions (and Counting) ● 3 Factions: Heroes, Monsters and Gods ● Unlock, Level Up and Upgrade Your Champions ● Send your Champions to special missions for great rewards ● 4 PvP modes ● eSports mode ● Global Rankings ● Players Clans and Chat ● Progress in Brawl Pass and Glory Road to claim great rewards ● Challenge 40 adventure puzzling stages for perfect completion/h2] Please Note ● Arena Tactics is currently in beta testing, under heavy development and with fast updates, don’t lose the chance to give your feedback from your game experience ● Arena Tactics is free to download and play, some in-app items can also be purchased for real money. In-app purchases can be disabled through your device’s settings. ● Network connection is required to play
row.short_description: Enter the Arena with your myths for turn-based fast-paced tactical PVP Fights!

row.name: Shaped Touches
row.detailed_description: Architecture is a ‘shaped touch’ between what our bodies can perceive and the information around us. As our bodies increase their range of sensorial abilities through advancements in healthcare and wearable technologies, climate change is simultaneously redefining our expectations of future environments. Examples include the ability to see within the near infrared spectrum of light, access layers of augmented reality, hear plants communicate in low frequency sound or the ability to empathize with those who’s senses differ from your own. Architecture’s shape is less of an objective form and more of a spectrum of sensorial shapes layered upon one another for those with varying access. Much like a radio dial, occupying the same space might not mean you’re tuned to the same architecture...leading to immense creativity as well as public space to potentially fragment even further. This game was installed as part of the 17th International Architecture Exhibition - La Biennale di Venezia.
row.short_description: 'Shaped Touches' is a simulation game of our future public spaces. Every 60 seconds, the game restarts in the same spaces with new sensory perceptions, experiencing the same place in new ways. This game was installed as part of the 17th International Architecture Exhibition - La Biennale di Venezia.

row.name: Mini Royale
row.detailed_description: Be a part of a growing community by joining our Discord Please wishlist the game and follow to support us About the Game Mini Royale: The Ultimate Toy Soldier Shooter! Mini Royale elevates the beloved toy soldier experience with creative weapons, gadgets, and dynamic movement. Swing from curtain rods, dodge between towering action figures, and zip across the room using the game’s signature grapple gun. Every match offers fresh and exciting ways to outmaneuver your opponents. Game Modes Battle Royale: Engage in an action-packed free-for-all where you fight to be the last soldier or team standing. Traverse chaotic, larger-than-life environments, making every match a new adventure. Color Conquest: Take on three other teams in a nostalgic twist on classic toy soldier battles. Eliminate enemy players to convert them to your team’s color until only one color remains. Deathmatch: Enter tightly packed arenas like the inside of a pinball machine, a sandbox, or a moving box filled with toys. Prove yourself as the ultimate deathmatch champion. ... and more to come! Movement Master a fluid movement system designed for quick, responsive action. Whether sliding down slopes, grappling into the air, parachuting into battle, or scaling any surface, every maneuver offers a unique edge in combat. Customization Express yourself on the battlefield! Choose from a wide array of cosmetics, including: Skins: Transform your toy soldier into a unique combatant. Emotes: Celebrate your victories with style. Gliders & Melee Weapons: Add flair to every move. Voicelines: Personalize your loadout and stand out in the crowd. Join Our Community We’re a passionate indie team crafting Mini Royale with love and creativity. Your feedback is crucial in shaping the future of the game. Join our vibrant community on Discord and be part of the journey!
row.short_description: Brace yourself for an action-packed shooter experience in Mini Royale! Battle as green army toy soldiers in a massive kids' bedroom, fighting for survival in modes like Battle Royale, Deathmatch, and more—where only the strongest players or teams claim victory.

row.name: Suspicious Downpour
row.detailed_description: Suspicious Downpour is a very short single-player comedy horror experience about getting stuck in a storm while out camping. Welcome to Hanawiti forest, a popular location for adventurous backpackers. Pitch a tent and stay the night in our lush and beautiful backyard. Enjoy the wildlife, enjoy the scenery and have an eye out for Mr. Wilson. Just make sure you don’t get caught in a rainstorm. Sit in your tent with your trusty flashlight in the calm rain and just relax to the sound of rain hitting your tent. Just be warned you may not be alone in the woods and If you look for trouble you just might find it... WARNING: Don’t feed the wildlife and don’t pack any meat. A Note Suspicious Downpour was originally designed and created in the space of a 48 hour game jam. The overall playtime reflects our short development period as the game can be finished in less than 30 minutes. The story isn't designed for multiple playthroughs however we designed the game with the intention that players can replay the game for the ambience and immersion. The keyboard is used as a puzzle mechanic as it is intentional that you cannot walk around About the Game Jam This game was created as an entry for the 2021 Aotearoa Game Jam. The theme was Light and Dark. Credits Hamish Oliver (HamishOliver) - Music, Sound, Design Benjamin Gulliver (fatherbeno) - UI/UX, Design, Programming Jared Bakker (Sugoi Yellow) - Graphics, Design, Programming
row.short_description: Suspicious Downpour is a very short single-player comedy horror experience about getting stuck in a storm while out camping. Sit in your tent with your trusty flashlight in the calm rain and just relax. Just be warned If you look for trouble you might find it.

row.name: The Elysian Field
row.detailed_description: In this third person exploration game centred around a soldier in his final moments in the Elysian field. Experience the final moments of a dying man as he wonders through the elysian field witnessing the last thoughts and memories of others before he too leaves his final mark. Players can explore an atmospheric environment and speak to another soldier before he too passes. Try to find some peace in these last moments before the eventual end comes. Key Features: 1) An atmospheric environment to be explored by players 2)An emotional soundtrack including the likes of Jakob Ahlbom and Silver Maple 3) A short emotional story (Around 5-10 Minutes) with little gameplay
row.short_description: A gorgeous 3rd person casual adventure game centred around a dying soldier wondering through the elysian field witnessing the final moments of those already gone before leaving his own final mark. Uncover memories and a final conversation before laying to rest.

row.name: Cactus Cowboy 3 - Fully Loaded
row.detailed_description: Cactus Cowboy is back in a new VR First Person Shooter adventure. Free Cactus World from the alien robot invasion with the help for your huge arsenal of deadly weapons. Shoot your way from your Cacti Desert all the way to the moon and fight back the Invasion alongside with the mighty cactus army! row.short_description: Cactus Cowboy is back, in a fully fledged story shooter made for experienced VR Gamers.

row.name: Ultimechs
row.detailed_description: The goal zones light up. The crowd roars. A perfectly engineered mech enters the arena under your control. Welcome to Ultimechs. Ultimechs lets players remotely pilot high-performance mechs that compete in the future of sport, working their way up the field with a teammate as they zoom, block, punch and score their way to victory. Taking everything that makes sports great today and combining it with the inconceivable technology of tomorrow, Ultimechs represents the pinnacle of engineered athletic achievement. Managing the direction and speed of a massive moving target is no small undertaking — and that’s why we’ve equipped our mechs with the latest in state-of-the-art GauntJet technology. Aim your fist, fire and control your punch in mid-air to line it up to find the ball’s sweet spot. Throw a heat-seeking haymaker to knock it out of your opponents’ reach, pass it to your teammate, or bash it into your target to score the winning goal. Going the distance to become an Ultimechs Champion takes more than grease, gas and gears — it takes a cooperative spirit as players communicate, strategize and react with their teammate as they partner up for 2v2 competition. Don’t play well with others? Players that are looking to hog all the glory of a win (or keep the sting of a loss to themselves) can also experience Ultimechs in 1v1 play. Choose from three distinct mech classes with their own style of play: the supersonic Viper that values speed and agility above all else; the explosive Nitro who can detonate their GauntJet in mid-flight; and the powerhouse Titan whose size and strength make them a true force to be reckoned with.
row.short_description: Your mech is ready. The crowd roars. Welcome to the arena! The thrill of professional athletics meets the precision of purpose-built machines in Ultimechs, the latest multiplayer VR gaming experience from Resolution Games.

row.name: Aces in the Dust
row.detailed_description: In an alternative world to ours, only a few years have passed since the discovery of the great capabilities and military uses of Mitrilia, a very rare and complicated to treat mineral. This discovery led to disputes between different countries that have ended in a war and various battles, which we will live through from the perspective of a group of elite airmen sent to defeat the enemy. In Aces in the Dust you are in the shoes of this elite group, made up of Varick, Dimitrii and Victoria, each one piloting a state-of-the-art warplane with unique characteristics that differentiate them. You must shoot enemies, avoid obstacles, know which weapon to use at all times and dodge hundreds of bullets if you want your pilots to survive each mission and get the highest scores possible. So prepare your weapons, aim well and ... finish the enemy! Aces in the Dust is inspired by classic rail shooter games such as Panzer Dragoon and Star Fox. Main features: - Play as a trio of pilots, each flying a unique plane with different characteristics. - Advance through the levels alternating between the different pilots to face different situations in the most favorable way. - Take out an array of enemies and a powerful final boss as you advance through enemy territory in a large rocky desert. - Dodge terrain obstacles while defeating enemies. - Defeat enemies without taking damage to achieve a good score at the end of levels.
row.short_description: Take command of a team of three elite Airmen! Each of them pilots a warplane equipped with the most powerful experimental weapons to date. Shoot down enemies using machine guns, missiles, energy cannons and… a laser beam? Venture into enemy territory and wreak havoc in this rail shooter.

row.name: Virtual Becomes Reality: A Stanford VR Experience
row.detailed_description: For nearly two decades, Stanford University's Virtual Human Interaction Lab has been a destination for world leaders, corporate executives, students, tourists, and community members to learn about the science behind Virtual Reality (VR). It was simple - every Friday at 4pm, the first 24 people who showed up got a tour of the lab. Soon one tour a week wasn't enough to meet demand as groups from all over the world became curious about this new technology. Over the years, at least 15,000 visitors made the trip. But now, travel to Stanford is no longer required. We are bringing the lab to you. In this immersive tour, you will learn about the power of presence, fly like a superhero, deepen your understanding of human impacts on the environment, become a football quarterback, meet Grover from Sesame Street, see yourself as another person, and even grow a third arm. With VR technology now widely available, it’s more important than ever to understand its impact on people and society. Join us in exploring how we can use this powerful medium to enhance our everyday lives. This piece is best experienced walking in a room scale set-up using both hand controllers. We also support seated and one-handed play. Note: One-handed play does not include the flying or third-arm scenes.
row.short_description: With Virtual Reality technology widely available, it’s more important than ever to understand its impact on people and society. Explore highlights of nearly two decades of research from Stanford's Virtual Human Interaction Lab and discover how we can use this medium to enhance our everyday lives.
row.reviews: “VIRTUAL BECOMES REALITY does an AMAZING job. It's a new interactive model for sharing XR knowledge.... A must-watch piece for anyone in the industry.” Kent Bye - Host of Voices of VR

row.name: Idle Atomic
row.detailed_description: Idle Atomic is an Incremental Idle RPG in a post-apocalyptic world. You stand alone in the wasteland and must fight monsters, salvage resources and refine materials to survive! Key features: - Defeat monsters, gain power, unlock new zones and hunt down bounties! - Gather a large variety of loot and discover rare salvaging spawns! - Use resources gathered to refine materials, craft permanent power-ups and suit upgrades, enhance item efficiency and more! - Unlock and cast fighting and utility spells, discover unique essence to enhance your spells! - Hunt 20+ mutant creatures that appear during gameplay, each with their own loot table! - Earn and level up companions to unlock powerful bonuses! - Complete various Tasks and Missions to unlock stat enhancements! - Find and use items to make yourself more powerful and provide helpful utilities! - Idle Wasteland has a plethora of content, play the game to discover much more!
row.short_description: Idle Atomic is an Incremental Idle RPG in a post-apocalyptic world. Level up skills, refine your salvaged materials and hunt mutant creatures to survive!

row.name: Vampire Slave 1: A Yaoi Visual Novel
row.detailed_description: The world's most ancient vampire, a young and unprepared new leader of a centuries old vampire-hunting organization, thrust together by fate. Thalos knows he's found his beloved, but Dusty must never let himself grow close to a vampire. A kinetic visual novel that grows spicier with each installment! Dusty is the next in line to lead the vampire hunting organization Jagerin, that's why he enrolled in the university owned by the world's most notorious vampire, Thalos. He hoped to learn more about his mortal enemy. Instead he ended up in the wrong place at the wrong time and is mistaken for the man Thalos chose as his next familiar. He's put in a trance and the irrevocable blood ritual is performed. Now Dusty is under Thalos' dark powers, and his mother has been murdered by the insidious vampire Johann. It's Dusty's turn to lead the global vampire-hunting organization, and his job to destroy Johann. He's not ready for either, and he's certainly not willing to be a vampire's familiar. Dusty has no choice but to join forces with the vampire he's irrevocably linked to. He needs his help against a new kind of evil vampire. He just has to make sure he doesn't wind up in bed with his new master in the process. Thalos, the immortal of immortals, has existed for eons, but he's never had a familiar who could share his dreams before. Dusty has a secret he's not letting Thalos unravel. Was their ill-fated meeting truly by chance? Based on the bestselling Vampire Slave novel by Yamila Abraham and illustrated by Italian studio Dany&Dany. Kinetic Visual Novels are the purest novel adaptions. There are no choices in the game. You play the most canonical route envisioned by the author. Enjoy the forbidden love story of vampire and hunter! Chapter 1 of 4 Press 'v' on your keyboard to have all text read aloud First Chapter Free, Subsequent Chapters Paid Chapters End on Riveting Cliffhangers Kinetic/Linear Game Play: No Choices A Modern Day BL Vampire Saga Based on a Bestselling Novel Art by Dany&Dany Suggestive Scenes of Copulation in Chapters 3 and 4
row.short_description: The world's most ancient vampire, a young & unprepared new leader of a centuries old vampire-hunting organization, thrust together by fate. Thalos knows he's found his beloved, but Dusty must never let himself grow close to a vampire. A kinetic visual novel that grows spicier with each installment!
row.notes: Violent deaths are referred to in the text. Vampire bites the main character and there is blood.

row.name: Creatures Docking Station
row.detailed_description: Set the Norns free! Hatch your very own virtual life forms in this incredible addition to the hit Creatures series. Norns are endearing little creatures who grow, learn and behave just like real living animals. Norns think and act for themselves and display real feelings such as hunger, pain, fear and boredom. They can even talk to you and to each other! Based on real biological principles, these furry little pets have their own biochemistry and Creatures digital DNA and represent one of the most advanced virtual life sims commercially available today. Creatures Docking Station is a fully self-contained world with four large rooms and contains all you need to raise and train families of Norns. There are food sources, toys and loads of plants and animals in a working eco-system. Disclaimer : The online features of Creatures Docking Station are no longer available. Hatch any number of Norns from 7 different breeds at any time. Each creature is completely unique with its own personality. The Norns in Creatures titles have digital DNA, so they can inherit characteristics from their digital ancestors and pass them on to their offspring. Expand your game with a huge number of fan-created additions such as new rooms, toys or breeds! Interact with your Norns and the ecosystem in a variety of ways and observe emergent behavior in action!
row.short_description: Raise and train a troupe of cuddly virtual life creatures that live on a Space Station. Because they have neural network brains, Norns can be taught right from wrong, but because they also have their own, individual personalities, they may not always do what you want.
row.reviews: “The combination of virtual pet as well as gameplay is done beautifully.” 10/10 – GameZone

row.name: Hideout: Face your fears
row.detailed_description: Immerse yourself in this third person stealth adventure, set in a world devastated by war against an artificial intelligence that brought down society as we knew it. Play as May, a survivor living in a bunker in the mountains that must go on a quest to find medicine for her sickly brother, Jack. In her way, she will meet the robots designed by the AI to hunt down humanity, an assembly of war machines who will not hesitate to kill her on sight. Her only way to survive will be to stay in the shadows and remain undetected, using her environment as cover. May has a tool that allows her to interact with various devices along the town: opening doors, powering generators, finding hidden information and crafting various objects that will help her along the way by distracting her enemies, revealing them or and even incapacitating them. In this slow-paced adventure game, the bleak setting and narrative create a tense and oppressive atmosphere that enhances the experience. May’s vulnerability only adds to the feeling of helplessness against the war machines: if she is found, it’s GAME OVER. Will you help May to save her brother and find the secret hidden within this town? Key Features: Navigate through three different environments: forest, town and laboratory. Face five different types of enemies, each with a different function. Discover the collectibles that hold a secret story. Solve the enigmas of the mysterious town. Create and use four different objects that interact with the enemies.
row.short_description: In this third person stealth game set in a post-apocalyptic world dominated by an artificial intelligence, you will take on the role of May in her quest to save her brother. Avoid the robots, explore the town and find its secrets!

row.name: Gray Death
row.detailed_description: Gray Death is a linear horror themed puzzle platformer, reminiscent of classic games like Solomon's Key and Dangerous Dave. The 20+ levels are short but challenging. You can either shoot or avoid enemies. You'll need to search for supplies and ammunition. The game can be switched between 2D and 2.5D. It's also the first episode in a planned series. Story After weeks of searching for food and supplies, Gray returns back to the compound he helped build. Gray finds his friend Red dying from a gunshot wound and learns that a group mutinied and another fled.
row.short_description: In a world full of demons and the undead, a man searches for his lost wife. Resources are limited. Death is instant and waiting in the darkness. You will be running, jumping, climbing and searching in this 2D or 2.5D puzzle platformer.

row.name: Figurine Scene Simulator
row.detailed_description: Join us on Discord for support, offer feedback and SFW/NSFW examples. Do you enjoy collecting figurines or maybe you'd like to, but you don't have the space or time? Ever want to pose figurines or create rich dioramas that can showcase them alone or interacting with each other? Figurine Scene Simulator (FSS) is a sandbox game where you can customize figurines into characters and build scene compositions for them when you: Choose figurines from a huge library spanning over a dozen genres Select from an initial dozen scene settings Pose figurines in the scene using animations and movement/rotation and scale tools. Use blendshapes to further customize the look and feel of the scene with figurine mood expressions (currently available on a small but growing number of figurines) Once you've added figurines to a scene, you have options to : Name and save them to create characters for your character portfolio Manage animations for each character with the ability to create a timeline with animations played in full, clipped to a specific time period or paused on an animation frame for a specified duration. Let the scene's figurine/character animation timelines play in sequence or randomly Capture Scenes, characters and animations in Mp4 and Jpeg formats. Premium Character Unlock DLC With the FSS Premium Character Unlock, you can create even more highly customized and detailed scenes by unlocking: Hundreds of additional figurine variants of the promo and base game figurines Ability to enable/disable clothing and other components for a large share of the figurines Ability to modify the body shape blendshapes for many of the figurines (these a separate from the expression blendshapes in the base game) Animation Poses, animations frozen in time and sometimes paired with another mirroring poses for a second character. This allows for quick posing in scenes and since many are couple based, poses cover situations we don't currently have animations for. Note: To provide a demo of what type of content the premium content unlocks, the base game includes a few unlocked characters, you can find them by clicking the 'Premium Unlock Demo' button displayed during 'Add Character' mode. ******************* Figurine Content Figurine Scene Simulator is based on a large collection of figurines. Pop into the series of franchises covering a wide range of genres and check out figurines from different collections in each genre. Currently, we have over 150 figurines with a growing number with expression blendshapes and you can pose them in scenes using thousands of animations and pre-set poses. The Premium Character Unlock adds an additional 200+ variants as well as hundreds of clothes and body components, and body part blendshapes. (horns, armor, etc) The vast majority of our figurine content will be included in the base game, for example, figurine DLC packs we might have released over the next couple of years while we are in early access will all be included. The exception to these are our small Promo Packs DLC. Promo Packs are small 1-3 figurine sets that add small extensions to the base content. The majority of Promo Packs are by designated spotlight artists and we give them a royalty gratuity for each sale, we will also have promo's released occasionally for a specific theme, such as our Launch Promo which features a mini-scene and 2 supporting figurines. Like physical collectible shops and stores, we get our figurines from a variety of artists and sources including stores like cgtrader and relationships with artists through patreon or directly. Some artists build their models from the ground up and some start with bases from character development tools. As such, not all figurines have a similar look and feel or the same features, and since they don't all have the same rigging, not all animations may look right on all figurines. We think that's part of the nature of collecting figurines and there's options like camera angles and other scene direction methods to make them look great or create specific artistic expressions by purposely playing off their contrasts. Digital Rarity Collector's Program Our Digital Rarity Collector's Program is intended to add a collectable rarity aspect to the game to reward long time players with some inexpensive content which goes up in price slowly, making it less likely other players who join later will be creating photobooks, etc with them. The system is designed so each time we release a new promo, it will drop at the lowest price you can set on steam (in USD), and we will also increase the price of another previously released promo by 1-3 steam price categories.
row.short_description: Figurine Scene Simulator is a sandbox game where you build a character portfolio from a huge library of figurines. You can place the figurines in scenes and set them to animations to compose artistic expressions and take screen and video captures. You can also expand your character options via DLC.
row.notes: Figurine Scene Simulator is meant to be a complete game which can be enjoyed without the use of NSFW type content. However, there is also a fair amount of NSFW type costumes and nudity*. This content will grow during development. In addition to some horror/gory figurines and scenes, additional fx will be added to allow for extremely violent/gory scenes. *Notes: By default, NSFW/Nudity is turned off, it's enabled in-game through settings. FSS is not intended to be a sex simulator, though it ranges per artist, the type of nudity is generally more "doll" like than realistic. While some is available in the base game, most nudity is unlocked through the Premium Character Creator DLC which allows you to turn on/off clothes components on a lot of figurines. All Characters are 18 or older.

row.name: Paper Enchantress
row.detailed_description: Возвращаясь домой с нелюбимой работы оказывается перед дверью. Одной из тех дверей, прикосновение к которым чревато снопом цветных искр, магической академией, висящей высоко над черепичными крышами, освещёнными закатным солнцем, встречей с обаятельным волшебником с каштановыми волосами, или, может быть, норовистой ведьмой, что прячет за улыбкой некую смутную тоску. Может быть за дверью есть тайна? Несомненно! Опасность? Возможно! Награда? Любовь? Обнажённые тела, сплетающиеся в древнем танце вожделения? Ну, тут гарантий нет, не серчай, сестрёнка. Стоит ли эта крайне мутная перспектива того, чтобы рискнуть статусной работой библиотекаря, ухаживаниями простого но надёжного Серёги из автомастерской и долготерпением родителей, справедливо напоминающих о тикании часов? Твоя рука ощущает наэлектризованность истёртой дверной ручки, течение воздуха, будто бы всасываемого в замочную скважину. Повернуть её? Или повернуться спиной к двери и твердым, уверенным шагом вернуться в строй приличных граждан? Paper Enchantress - визуальная новелла в сеттинге романтического фэнтези с богатой вариативностью выборов развития сюжета. В игре присутствуют несколько любовных линий с персонажами обоих полов, определяющих несколько возможных концовок новеллы. Особенности игры: динамичный сюжет, развивающийся в зависимости от выбора игрока; 70 тысяч слов на 3-4 часа чтения; яркие персонажи с захватывающими личными историями; уникальный графический стиль; шутки, шутейки, шутканчики и прочие производные искорометнотного юмора;
row.short_description: Paper Enchantress - это романтическое приключение полное магии, судьбоносных решений и прекрасных принцев. Что откроется за таинственной дверью?

row.name: Ultimate Physical Wrestling
row.detailed_description: A professional wrestling game that can be played with that 'ring-shaped controller'! Four wrestlers stand in front of you! Use your own body to make your move! Accumulate power to perform tricks! Tilt that ring-shaped controller well and get power! When you get it, you can get more power by pushing it with your muscles! If you have enough power, you can do your tricks! Use that ring-shaped controller to perform professional wrestling techniques! Input striking techniques, throwing techniques, and joint techniques with a ring-shaped controller! If you can input using muscles firmly, it will cause a lot of damage, but if it is poor, it will not do any damage! Escape from enemy joints! [/] When you have a joint technique, pull that ring-shaped controller violently to escape! Defeat 4 wrestlers! [/] The four wrestlers are always strong enemies! Those who are good at batting and those who like joints have different characteristics. The last wrestler is ridiculously strong!
row.short_description: A professional wrestling game that can be played with that 'ring-shaped controller'! Four wrestlers stand in front of you! Use your own body to make your move!

row.name: The Wolf's Den
row.detailed_description: There are forces in the world that no man should ever tinker with. However, that didn't stop two alchemists, Caesar and Marcus, from performing their wretched experiments with the unknown. Disaster strikes, and Marcus now finds himself in mortal peril trying to escape the ruins of his old laboratory in a seemingly deserted train tunnel, running through the heart of the mountain. Unbeknownst to him, something lurks in the dark of the passageway, something never before seen by mortal eyes. Can you help Marcus escape the clutches of this unseen terror? In order to do that, you must enter The Wolf's Den ! The Wolf's Den is a short first person experience through a dark and mysterious world. Explore a dark mysterious train tunnel on your way to escape from a tragic accident that destroyed you and your partner's lab. Something is not quite right though and it's not just the uncomfortable noises emanating from the darkness. You will have to use your wits to uncover the mysteries of what happened to your partner Caesar, to figure out who is writing these mysterious notes, and to make sense of everything that's going on around you! Features include: Short linear single-player experience. Complete it within a day! Suspenseful first-person exploration in an atmospheric world. Full voice acting with subtitle support. Hidden secrets for extra replayability. Steam achievements and cloud saves.
row.short_description: The Wolf's Den is a suspenseful first person experience through a dark atmospheric mountain. Explore a mysterious train tunnel on your way to escape from a tragic accident that destroyed you and your partner's lab and uncover the truth behind the mysteries that surround you. Enter The Wolf's Den!

row.name: Arausio
row.detailed_description: Explore this accurate reconstitution of the ancient theatre of Arausio and solve the mystery: who destroyed the statue of the emperor Augustus? Meet numerous characters from the Roman antiquity and discover all about this incredible era of human history! Or, if you’re in a calmer mood, simply do a virtual tour of the theatre. Are you ready to dive into History?
row.short_description: Explore the ancient theatre of Arausio and discover Roman antiquity in this narrative exploration game!

row.name: Party Host 85
row.detailed_description: Throw the greatest parties in human history! You're grounded while your parents go on a world trip without you. Throw a bunch of parties and invite the most popular guests to earn some money to go on your very own vacation! In this game you are the host of a simulated party and need to take care of everything. Clean up after your guests, talk to them to get to know them better and select the right music for your crowd. Make decissions on what you want your party to be like by turning on the TV or let someone sell illegal stuff on your frontyard. And you might wanna remember where the fire extinguiser is... just in case. Get to know your guests to better plan ahead and keep them entertained. Find out which guests play along nicely and make good choices on who you invite in the planning phase. And don't forget to buy enough food, drinks and drugs to keep your guests entertained. Be careful not to burn down the house or get in trouble with the police though. Become ever more popular to unlock new party guests by having great discussions with them on interesting topics. Get acquainted with 14 crazy characters and they might even sign your yearbook. Discover all the crazy things that can happen and a mystery below the surface.
row.short_description: Party like it's 1985! You're the host of the wildest party of the century and have to plan and execute a succesful event. Get to know all the crazy characters and discover what they will do once the party started.
row.notes: There are very pixelated depictions of nudity and references to illegal drugs.

row.name: Pirates
row.detailed_description: Pirates Welcome to the exciting world of pirates! You find yourself on a remote island where you can either go it alone or team up with other players to battle against hostile skeletons. Build impressive accommodations and gather valuable resources to elevate your survival skills to new heights. With a well-thought-out building system, crafting, farming, and culinary expertise, you can create truly remarkable things. Your skills and survival prowess are in demand! Here are some of the special features that Pirates has to offer: A comprehensive quest and skill system that provides variety and challenge. An exciting single-player mode that allows you to explore the island's secrets at your own pace. A roaring multiplayer mode where you can compete with up to 64 other players. Online connectivity via a reliable P2P network, ensuring smooth adventures and providing server password protection. A versatile building system that challenges and nurtures your creativity and strategic abilities. A thoughtful crafting system that enables you to craft equipment and tools to enhance your combat capabilities. An inventory system that helps you organize your loot and resources. A challenging fishing system for catching fresh bounty from the ocean. A breeding system that lets you cultivate exotic animals and plants. A profound combat system that demands quick reflexes and strategic thinking. A comprehensive skill tree that allows you to develop your character according to your preferences. A character system that allows you to create your own pirate legend. Prepare for an epic adventure where you take control of your destiny. Become a feared pirate, a skilled craftsman, or a master of the island. The choice is yours! Set sail for the world of Pirates and experience a life beyond the horizon. Are you ready to leave your mark on this mysterious island?
row.short_description: (Sandbox Game) You play as a pirate on a remote island, surviving alone or with other players as you battle hostile skeletons. Construct a shelter and gather resources to fortify your survival.
row.notes: Depictions of violence during fights

row.name: Tanks: The Crusades
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Tanks: The Crusades! Tanks is a top-down shooter in which you control a blue tank and try to defeat various enemy tanks with assorted abilities to clear levels. You can play Tanks in multiple gamemodes, alone or via cross-platform multiplayer with as many friends as you'd like. Gamemodes Random levels: Play in randomly generated levels. Crusades: Play a series of levels in order, earning coins and unlocking shop items as you go, with a limited number of lives. Versus: Fight your friends in randomly generated levels. My levels: Play levels that you have saved or made. Features Level editor: You can create your own levels, featuring tank teams, custom items and shops, custom background colors, and custom level sizes. Go wild! Crusade editor: Once you've made (or saved) several levels, you can put them together into your own crusade. You can then set up a shop for that crusade where players can spend their coins. Multiplayer: Play with as many other players as your device can support. You can play in co-op or versus, chat, and share levels and crusades you've made in multiplayer parties.
row.short_description: A top-down shooter with tanks that have various assorted abilities, with support for multiplayer and a level editor.

row.name: BATTLE STEED : GUNMA (배틀 스티드 : 군마)
row.detailed_description: BATTLE STEED : GUNMA is a team battle robot TPS game implemented with 3D giant robots, and the main story of the game is the battle that takes place in a competition between military companies from each countries to acquire new resources discovered on the space planets, Mars, and Earth, in the near future. Control the giant robot with various skills and weapons, keep enemy in check by cooperating with alliance, and performs various missions such as occupying the base of the battle area or collecting resources. Various battle modes such as siege war, node war, greedy mode, or others are randomly matched, and users can team up to 6 vs 6 after selecting one of 7 types of robots, this feature makes you able to play the battle in various way. You can see your game play information you played through 'Career' tab.
row.short_description: BATTLE STEED:GUNMA is a team battle TPS game implemented with giant robots. Join as a mercenary and win with your team in the battle that takes place in a competition between military companies from each countries to acquire new resources discovered on the space planets in the near future.
